sources.quote: WASP-69, also named Wouri, is a K-type main-sequence star 164 light-years away from Earth in the constellation Aquarius.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Allart et al. 2025.

sources.quote: Its surface temperature is 4782±15 K. WASP-69 is slightly enriched in heavy elements compared to the Sun, with a metallicity Fe/H index of 0.10±0.01, and is much younger than the Sun at 2 billion years.
